8507908055.description:
Top cap or housing made of aluminium or ferrous alloy or stainless steel:
-whether or not including parts made of aluminum and aluminium alloy,
-with or without sealing elements or other elements made of polymer material,
-with or without a "current interrupt device " and an "evacuation valve"
-with or without plastic sockets
-with an outer diameter of 17 mm or more, but not more than 18 mm,
or rectangular with:
-length not greater than 450 mm,
-width not greater than 200 mm, and
-hight not greater than 150 mm,
for use in the manufacture of lithium-ion batteries
